name: doc-review-pipe
description: Review docs, extract structured findings, pipe through formatter, deliver to writer

config.task: Review the README.md and any docs/ files in this project. Identify gaps, typos, outdated info, and missing sections.

fields.name: issues
fields.description: Each documentation issue found, one per entry

fields.name: severity
fields.description: Overall documentation quality — high means blocking issues

fields.name: missing_sections
fields.description: Sections that should exist but don't

fields.name: outdated
fields.description: Statements that are no longer accurate

completionSchema.purpose: Your findings feed a formatting script that groups issues by type
completionSchema.stickyDescription: Fill out every field carefully — the formatter needs structured data

config.content: You will receive a formatted report of documentation issues. For each issue, write the corrected text or new section content.

config.message: Doc review pipeline complete — see #writer for results
